review_notes: I read the whole file (four theorems) and checked it against the repeated-proof-machinery rubric. The proofs have different goals: Sylow conjugacy in the automorphism image (`exists_mem_inf_rhoL_eq`), a commutator-style factorisation (`conj_mem_of_rhoL_eq`), and a deduction of normalisation (`inf_normalizer_le_normalizer_of_inner`). The last theorem, `exists_not_inner_of_not_le_normalizer`, is a thin contrapositive wrapper. The only recurring pieces are short: membership-in-subgroupOf bookkeeping, `mem_normalizer_iff`, and the closing `x⁻¹` trick that upgrades forward closure to normalizer membership. I judged each too short or too routine to justify a shared lemma. A grep of the rest of the repository for the same patterns turned up only generic uses of `mem_normalizer_iff`, not a repeated nontrivial argument. I did not find a substantive duplicated block, so I report no finding. I did not exhaustively compare this file with every other file in the repository, so some uncertainty remains about duplication across files.
